title: INTEGRATING LLMS FOR GRADING AND APPEAL RESOLUTION IN COMPUTER SCIENCE EDUCATION

bias_targets.methodology: Statistical analysis utilizing Pearson and Spearman correlation coefficients to compare exam scores generated by different LLMs (ChatGPT-4o, Gemini 2.0 Pro) under varying configurations, identifying algorithmic inconsistencies and latent grading styles.
Measuring intra-rater and inter-rater reliability by having multiple human graders with differing levels of experience independently assess the same batch of exam responses across different sessions.
